caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden cabinet with a natural light brown finish, featuring two main sections. The upper section consists of a pair of vertical doors with a central round knob, bordered by narrow vertical panels on each side of the doors, and hinges visible along the outer vertical edges. Directly below this section, there are three drawers, each with a round wooden pull handle, set in a horizontal row. The lower half of the cabinet is slightly wider, protruding outward beneath the drawers, and contains two larger cabinet doors, each with a round knob and bordered by narrow vertical panels with hinges. The cabinet stands on four short legs that form a subtle arch at the bottom edge. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details, emphasizing the shape and color of the cabinet.
title: Shaker Cupboard
